sourceConflicts.finding: Point estimate, ±20%, or undifferentiated AUC/Cmax/Tmax descriptions omit the statistical criterion.
sourceConflicts.resolution: Ordinary 90% geometric-ratio CI criterion and parameter-specific scope reconciled with ICH M13A.

sourceConflicts.finding: Exemptions summarized as matching ingredients or whole-route categories.
sourceConflicts.resolution: No blanket exemption; bounded M9 criteria and special-route limitations.

sourceConflicts.finding: Indirect comparison figure labelled non-equivalent and generalized switching risk.
sourceConflicts.resolution: Non-transitivity of estimates is not a direct A–B trial or evidence of a general substitution prohibition.

sourceConflicts.finding: Older advice against changing stable patients on biologics.
sourceConflicts.resolution: AIFA official 29 April2026 summary distinguishes interchangeability and informed switch; not autonomous change.

sourceConflicts.finding: Transparency list described as all authorized generics.
sourceConflicts.resolution: List has defined inclusion/reimbursement criteria; no universal inventory claim.

sourceConflicts.finding: Historic marketing statistics, isomer availability and broad toxicity language.
sourceConflicts.resolution: Use stereoselectivity principle only; no current-market or superior-isomer claim.

sourceConflicts.finding: Lesson6 date printed10/10/2025 precedes lesson5 dated13/10/2025.
sourceConflicts.resolution: Retain printed metadata with unresolved conflict.
